question: Should existing GitHub Copilot OAuth profiles be switched from their stored access credential to the stored refresh credential for all runtime requests after post-rebase upgrade proof confirms that contract?
rationale: This changes which persisted credential is sent to Copilot across several runtime surfaces; source-level patch review cannot safely choose the long-term credential and upgrade contract without maintainer intent and live evidence.

options.title: Require upgrade proof before merge
options.body: Rebase the PR and provide redacted terminal or runtime-log evidence for fine-grained PAT and existing OAuth-profile flows, including model streaming and custom-embeddings credential isolation.

options.title: Preserve the existing OAuth runtime credential
options.body: Keep the current stored access credential for existing OAuth profiles and limit source-token runtime auth to newly authenticated profiles until a migration contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Require upgrade proof before merge
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and provide redacted terminal or runtime-log evidence for fine-grained PAT and existing OAuth-profile flows, including model streaming and custom-embeddings credential isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current author has the most direct implementation context for the proposed credential transition, though feature-history ownership remains unverified.
